summary: Kept the form, relief, materials and massing; added 90 street-level detail blocks with edit2.mjs (v2.nbt to build.nbt). The two side exits got blackstone-stair awnings with cream slab fringes and hanging lanterns. Lamp posts and planter beds now line both sides, the back lane and the front corners. `mcd check` shows 0 floating blocks and 0 function violations; all four sides were rendered.
applied: Small details a player notices: awnings over both side exit doors, each with two hanging lanterns
Small details a player notices: 10 new lamp posts (nether-brick fence + lantern): 4 per side street pair, 2 on the back lane, 2 at the front corners
Small details a player notices: 9 more planter beds (azalea, flowering azalea, allium on blackstone-brick bases) along the side streets and back lane, clear of the doors
Reviewer name 'Art deco cinema with tower' already matches the brief, so no fix was needed; wall relief, material range and massing were left untouched
skipped: Vertical blade signs on the side walls: tried, but they ran off the grid edge and left 2 orphan blocks, so I removed them. Lettering and signs already exist on the tower, marquee, ticket booth and exit doors.
Awning over the back exit doors: a fin sits right over the door (6,4,34), so there was no room. The back doors got flanking lamps and planters instead.
Front awnings: the marquee, hanging lanterns and poster cases already cover the front. More there would crowd the entrance and clash with the Art Deco look.
palette warnings (cyan_terracotta outlier, black banners on black): these belong to the kept sunburst field and posters, which already work, and I did not add them
